about_the_game:
Ziiiip-bzzzzz-ZAP! You and the kids of Havenview were playing Lazer Blasters at the Arcade when the Oozeborgs attacked! Who knew that they were weak to small beams of light? Together it’s up to you and your Alien Pal Ozzy to save the day!

WELCOME TO HAVENVIEW

Zap your way through Havenview, a 90’s inspired playground of a town. With multiple locations, you’re sure to have a blast with up to 5 other players. Each trip through Havenview will be different thanks to our randomly generated levels and the Oozeborgs tearing up the place!

A THREAT FROM BEYOND THE COSMOS

The Oozeborgs showed up out of nowhere and the adults are too scared to help!
What are they here for?
How evil are they?
IS THAT A GIANT SPIDER MECH?
You’ll find no shortage of baddies to blast in these foes.

REBUILD THE ARCADE

Those Oozeborgs crashed right into our favorite hangout. Now we’ll have to rebuild it with the help of our Extra-terrific-strial pal Ozzy. Unlock prizes, upgrades and more to help in the fight for Havenview!

EXPAND YOUR ARSENAL

With 10+ classes to find, and many more class remixes - boredom won’t be found here! Play how you want and experiment with combining abilities with your friends.

Save Havenview!

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS (64bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 or higher

short_description: Havenview is an all-ages twin stick shooter with rogue-lite progression. Play with up to 6 players to help the kids of Havenview defeat the invading Oozeborgs. Unlock new classes, upgrades and blast your way to their Mothership - Save Havenview!
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Russian
*languages with full audio support
